05-player-open.what: A step card replaces the verdict pill.
05-player-open.why: The finding, where it happened and Play/Next sit together, so the swing opens on its first finding rather than on the address frame with nothing drawn.
05-player-open.who: the earlier pass (Opus and Fable reviews)

05-player-open.what: The drawing is up on the finding's own frame.
05-player-open.why: Showing the problem without a tap: the player is paused where the fault is.

05-player-open.what: Level badges on the P1–P10 strip.
05-player-open.why: The strip doubles as a map of where the swing went wrong.

07-all-checks.what: 'Every check' sheet with a summary line.
07-all-checks.why: One place for every number, kept off the step card and the drawings (Ruari asked for numbers to move out of the coaching card).

11-auto-recap.what: Recap card with a picture of the theme.
11-auto-recap.why: The camera screen shows what kept happening in the last swings, with one example.

01-library.what: A dense Photos-style grid of square tiles (pinch for 2, 3 or 5 columns), each showing the impact frame.
01-library.why: More swings at a glance, and tiles that differ from each other; the golfer finds a swing by its picture, not by reading.

01-library.what: One filled 'Review' button and a quiet 'Select'.
01-library.why: One primary action per row; a bare golfer glyph became a labelled action.

01-library.what: Lime accent as the app tint, a darker lime ink in light mode.
01-library.why: One accent instead of system blue, lime and green; status colours stay status-only.

03-session-review.what: One mark per swing: tick, amber '!', red '!!' or dash, in a 44 pt target.
03-session-review.why: Severity reads by shape as well as colour, so it survives colour blindness and glare.

03-session-review.what: 'Start here' leads, with the finding and its severity word.
03-session-review.why: The first thing to work on is the first thing read; the tally steps back to a heading.

05-player-open.what: Only this finding's drawing, with the ring sized to the head and the zone as an outlined band.
05-player-open.why: One idea on the frame at a time; the gap between head and zone is the message.

05-player-open.what: A short step card: where, '1/4', a glyph badge (! or !!) with its word, the finding, Play and a lime Next.
05-player-open.why: Readable at a glance from the tripod; caveats and legends moved one tap deeper. The card sits low, so the feet and ball stay visible.
05-player-open.who: Ruari; all four members (glyph badge: Opus, Fable, Gemini)

05-player-open.what: Tools fold away during the walkthrough, captioned 'Tools'.
05-player-open.why: More of the golfer, and every control on the player now has a word under it.

05-player-open.what: The current position is always selected; level badges sit in their own slot above each pose.
05-player-open.why: State is never ambiguous, and a badge clearly belongs to its pose.

07-all-checks.what: Leads with '11 of 16 judged checks in zone', then the top finding.
Each reading on a zone track; guide rows say 'Reference only' and are drawn dashed and neutral.
07-all-checks.why: A golfer sees where the swing sits against the good zone without comparing numbers, and a guide can't be mistaken for a pass.

09-swing-info.what: Dark, near-opaque sheet with Done and inset cards; 'Low · 50%' as one value.
09-swing-info.why: The same sheet style over the player everywhere, with no video ghosting through text.

10-player-address-P1.what: The folded finding says 'Jump to impact finding'.
10-player-address-P1.why: It reads as an action, not as a verdict on the frame you're looking at.

10-player-address-P1.what: The frame's name in the transport row, with 'Low confidence' when it applies.
10-player-address-P1.why: One place for 'where am I', instead of a floating pill and a repeated time.

11-auto-recap.what: Recap cut to the finding, one picture and 'Compare last 5'.
11-auto-recap.why: Read in a second on the walk back to the tripod, and it covers far less of the camera view.

11-auto-recap.what: Auto's state lives in the toggle: the segment fills lime and reads 'Auto ready'.
11-auto-recap.why: The live camera stays clear; no banner over the viewfinder.

12-auto-compare.what: Keys only what the tiles draw.
12-auto-compare.why: No legend entries for marks that aren't on screen.

12-auto-compare.what: Not-judged tile says why ('Short swing') in the same grid.
12-auto-compare.why: An unjudged swing reads as a decision, not a broken thumbnail.

14-auto-camera.what: Auto ready in the toggle; the big 'Auto is on' panel is gone.
14-auto-camera.why: Camera view first: the toggle already says the mode.

14-auto-camera.what: 'Recap: 5' sits in the top row beside '240 fps', in the same pill.
14-auto-camera.why: Settings stay at the edge; nothing centred over where the golfer's hands and club are at the top.
Secondary information stays small and out of the frame.
